name: Plagueborn
description:
About This Game

Descend Into a Dying World

The plague did not fade. It burrowed deeper.

Beneath shattered kingdoms and frost-scarred forests, something ancient is stirring again. Each descent into the dungeon reveals fractured ruins, forgotten prisons, and horrors twisted by corruption.

Every run is procedurally generated.
Every floor reshapes the battlefield.
Every choice pushes you closer to the source.

Fight. Adapt. Descend.

1–6 Player Co-Op Carnage

Survive alone — or bring allies.

Form a party of up to six players and carve through shifting dungeon floors filled with elite enemies, ambush encounters, and brutal bosses. Revive fallen allies, hold the frontline, or unleash devastation from the shadows.

The plague does not scale down its cruelty.
Neither should you.

Build Synergy That Evolves Each Run

After every floor, you choose how you evolve.

Gain powerful passives that modify abilities, trigger on-hit effects, empower allies, or transform your role entirely. Stack synergies. Break combinations. Discover unexpected interactions.

No two runs feel the same.
No two builds play the same.

Combat With Weight

Every strike lands with impact.

Block at the last second. Break enemy poise. Interrupt deadly casts. Chain abilities into devastating combos. Master positioning, stamina, and timing — because reckless aggression will get you killed.

Fast. Heavy. Intentional.

Weapons That Define Your Playstyle

Your weapon is your identity.

Wield sword and shield to dominate the frontline.
Strike from the shadows with daggers.
Unleash arcane destruction through staves.

Each weapon changes how you fight — abilities, pacing, and combat rhythm included.

A Dungeon That Fights Back

Three escalating floors.
Safe rooms to choose your fate.
A boss that will test everything you’ve built.

You are not a hero.
You are Plagueborn.
short_desc: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.
